name: Retail Inventory Management
description: Retail inventory system with product catalog, supplier data, and stock levels. Practice inventory management and procurement analysis.

tables.name: suppliers
tables.description: Supplier directory with location, lead times, and vendor ratings

tables.name: products
tables.description: Product catalog with SKU, category, and retail pricing

tables.name: inventory
tables.description: Stock levels per product-supplier combination with reorder tracking

relationships.description: Each inventory record tracks stock for one product
Each inventory record is sourced from one supplier

sample_queries.title: Low Stock Alert
sample_queries.description: Products where current stock is at or below reorder point
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  p.product_name,
  p.category,
  i.current_stock,
  i.reorder_point,
  i.stock_status,
  s.supplier_name,
  s.lead_time_days,
  i.unit_cost_idr
FROM inventory i
JOIN products p ON i.sku = p.sku
JOIN suppliers s ON i.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
WHERE i.current_stock <= i.reorder_point
ORDER BY i.current_stock ASC;

sample_queries.title: Inventory Value by Category
sample_queries.description: Total stock value and margin analysis grouped by product category
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  p.category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) as product_count,
  SUM(i.current_stock) as total_units,
  SUM(i.current_stock * i.unit_cost_idr) as total_cost_value,
  SUM(i.current_stock * p.retail_price_idr) as total_retail_value,
  ROUND((SUM(i.current_stock * p.retail_price_idr) - SUM(i.current_stock * i.unit_cost_idr)) * 100.0 / SUM(i.current_stock * p.retail_price_idr), 1) as margin_pct
FROM products p
JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY total_retail_value DESC;

sample_queries.title: Supplier Performance Ranking
sample_queries.description: Rank suppliers by rating and average lead time
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  s.supplier_name,
  s.city,
  s.vendor_rating,
  s.lead_time_days,
  COUNT(i.inventory_id) as products_supplied,
  SUM(i.current_stock * i.unit_cost_idr) as total_supply_value
FROM suppliers s
LEFT JOIN inventory i ON s.supplier_id = i.supplier_id
GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, s.city, s.vendor_rating, s.lead_time_days
ORDER BY s.vendor_rating DESC;
